Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks for connecting with Almond Bank on the RFP. Our procurement and security teams are consolidating answers and we have a short list of operational questions we need to include in the final submission. Can you please confirm the following at a level we can include in the RFP workbook? We need responses by end of day Friday so legal can review.

1) TAM coverage model: hours of coverage (local business hours vs 24x7), overlap windows for handoffs, escalation phone numbers for P1s.
2) On-call rotation cadence and average response SLA for a P1/P2 (time to acknowledge, time to deliver workaround).
3) Incident communications cadence and channels (email, phone, status page, Slack/Webhook), and who is the primary technical contact for incidents.
4) Evidence: can you provide a sample roster and a one-page SLA summary we can attach?
5) If we require industry-standard SOC2 evidence or any audit logs retention details, who on your side should we send that to?

Appreciate concise answers we can paste into our workbook. Happy to do a 30-minute call if it's easier — we have availability Thursday 10-12 PT.

Best,

Hi Sonia — attaching the requested one-page SLA summary and a redacted TAM roster for Almond Bank. Quick deliverables included below (you can paste into your workbook):

1) TAM coverage model:
- Standard TAM (included): 9x5 business hours support; TAM is primary contact during business hours (M-F, 9am–6pm PT).
- Optional 24x7 TAM add-on: continuous on-call rotation with a named escalation ladder for P1 incidents.

2) On-call rotation & SLAs:
- P1 acknowledgement: 15 minutes (24x7) / 60 minutes (9x5)
- P2 acknowledgement: 4 hours (9x5)
- Target initial mitigation (24x7, where feasible): 4 hours to a workaround; remediation window depends on severity and root cause.

3) Incident communications:
- Primary channels: Pager (phone/SMS) + Email for acknowledgements, Status Page for customer-visible updates, and optional Slack channel or webhook integration for real-time updates.
- Primary technical contact: named TAM (see roster) with backup TAMs listed. For escalations we provide an after-hours escalation phone number for customers on the 24x7 plan.

4) Evidence & audit details:
- Sample roster and SLA summary attached. SOC2 reports and audit log retention details can be provided under NDA; please direct requests to security@redwood.ai or share your preferred upload.

Attachments: TAM_Roster_AlmondBank.xlsx, SLA_Summary_Commitments_v1.pdf

If you'd like, we can take the short call Thursday 10:30 PT (we'll send a calendar invite) to walk through the items and confirm any redlines your security or legal team needs.
